name: janitor
description: Behavior-preserving codebase care: cleaner removes dead code and deduplicates, manager restructures files and directories, and docs-cleaner audits documentation and open-source readiness without changing code behavior.

interface.longDescription: Cleaner removes dead code, splits oversized files, and merges duplicates; manager restructures files and directories; docs-cleaner audits and improves documentation and open-source readiness, all without changing code behavior.
defaultPrompt: Use Janitor to clean up this codebase without changing behavior.
Find dead code, duplicate logic, and oversized files.
Refactor this code while keeping the public API stable.
Restructure oversized files and regroup directories without changing behavior.
Audit and improve this project's documentation and open-source readiness.
